title: Courtesy Schedule for Waivers of Early Pre-K Tuition Late Fees
content:
**Schedule.** Under the courtesy schedule of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, a waiver of a Pre-K tuition late fee has an amount added according to the late fee's place among the enrollment's late fees in the school year:

| The late fee is the enrollment's | Added to the waiver |
|---|---|
| first in the school year | 10.00 |
| second in the school year | 7.50 |
| third or later in the school year | nothing |

## Examples (hypothetical enrollments)

- The enrollment's only late fee this school year is the one being waived: it is the first, so 10.00 is added.
- Late fees were posted for October and January; the January fee is being waived: it is the second, so 7.50 is added.
- The fee being waived is the enrollment's fourth this school year: nothing is added.
